name: E2E: Fulfiller uses Agentforce in Salesforce console to manage incident
objective: Validate that a fulfiller can use Agentforce inside Salesforce to locate, summarize, update, and resolve an incident.
precondition: Fulfiller is logged into Salesforce. Incident INC-000001518 exists. Agentforce is enabled for fulfillers.

steps.description: Navigate to incident record page in Salesforce
steps.expectedResult: Incident record page loads with Proactive Assistance section visible

steps.description: Click Agentforce button in Salesforce header
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce utility bar panel opens with greeting and suggested actions

steps.description: Ask Agentforce to summarize the incident
steps.testData: Input: 'Summarize incident INC-000001518'. Locator: textarea[placeholder='Describe your task or ask a question…']
steps.expectedResult: Agentforce retrieves and displays incident summary

steps.description: Ask Agentforce to update incident status
steps.testData: Input: 'Change status of INC-000001518 to In Progress'

steps.description: Ask Agentforce to add work notes
steps.testData: Input: 'Add work notes: Investigating Windows update KB5039211 compatibility'
steps.expectedResult: Work notes are added to the incident

steps.description: Ask Agentforce to resolve the incident
steps.testData: Input: 'Resolve INC-000001518 with resolution: Rolled back Windows update. Outlook now works.'
steps.expectedResult: Incident status changes to Resolved with resolution notes captured

executionResult.blockerMessage: I do not currently have access to the details of this incident. This may be due to data access restrictions.
observations: Agentforce panel in Salesforce does NOT inherit context from the currently viewed record
Suggested actions displayed: 'Summarize this incident for tracking updates', 'Add a comment to this incident', 'Reopen this incident if it is resolved'

Proactive Assistance section buttons (Summarize Incident, Create Root Cause Summary, Associate Similar Incidents, Propose Resolution Summary) are visible on the record page but blocked by Agentforce overlay

salesforceConsoleLocators.agentforceTextarea: textarea[placeholder='Describe your task or ask a question…']
salesforceConsoleLocators.summarizeIncidentAction: span with text 'Summarize Incident' (in Shadow DOM)
salesforceConsoleLocators.incidentPathSteps: New → In Progress → On Hold → Resolved → Cancelled → Re-Open → Closed
